name: Fluxknight - CRM Follow-up Automation - Multi Tenant v3.1

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const required=['organization_id','agent_id','idempotency_key','event_type','input']; const missing=required.filter(k=>b[k]===undefined||b[k]===null||b[k]===''); if(missing.length) throw new Error('Missing required tenant fields: '+missing.join(', ')); const allowed=['follow_up.due','follow_up.manual','lead.stale','task.retry']; if(!allowed.includes(b.event_type)) throw new Error('Unsupported follow-up event'); const input=b.input||{}; const customerKey=String(b.customer_id||input.customer_key||input.email||input.phone||'').trim(); if(!customerKey) throw new Error('customer_id or customer identifier required'); return [{json:{organization_id:String(b.organization_id),organization_key:String(b.organization_key||input.organization_key||''),agent_id:String(b.agent_id),conversation_id:b.conversation_id||null,customer_id:b.customer_id||null,customer_key:customerKey,lead_id:b.lead_id||input.lead_id||null,task_id:b.task_id||input.task_id||null,idempotency_key:String(b.idempotency_key),channel:String(b.channel||input.preferred_channel||'internal'),event_type:b.event_type,input,workflow_key:'crm_follow_up_v3'}}];

parameters.body: ={{JSON.stringify({organization_id:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.organization_id,agent_id:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.agent_id,conversation_id:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.conversation_id,idempotency_key:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.idempotency_key,input:{...$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.input,organization_key:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.organization_key,workflow_key:'crm_follow_up_v3',channel:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.channel,event_type:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.event_type,customer_id:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.customer_id,customer_key:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.customer_key,lead_id:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.lead_id,task_id:$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json.task_id,follow_up_policy:$('Check Tenant Follow-up Eligibility').first().json.policy,follow_up_eligibility:$('Check Tenant Follow-up Eligibility').first().json.eligibility}})}}

parameters.jsCode: const env=$('Validate Follow-up Envelope').first().json; const gate=$('Check Tenant Follow-up Eligibility').first().json; const snap=$json.snapshot; if(!snap) throw new Error('Runtime snapshot not found'); const schema={action:'send|reschedule|handoff|close|skip',channel:'whatsapp|email|web_chat|telegram|voice|internal',priority:'low|normal|high|urgent',reason:'string',message:'string|null',subject:'string|null',lead_stage:'new|contacted|qualified|nurturing|appointment|won|lost|inactive',task_status:'completed|scheduled|cancelled|blocked',next_follow_up_at:'ISO datetime|null',handoff_required:'boolean',handoff_reason:'string|null',stop_sequence:'boolean',sequence_step:'number',memory_facts:[{type:'preference|fact|goal|objection|follow_up',summary:'string',confidence:'0-1'}]}; const policy=gate.policy; return [{json:{...env,execution_id:$('Queue Follow-up Execution').first().json.execution_id,policy,eligibility:gate.eligibility,provider_request:{execution_id:$('Queue Follow-up Execution').first().json.execution_id,organization_id:env.organization_id,agent_id:env.agent_id,instructions:snap.compiled_prompt+'\nYou are executing an organization-specific follow-up policy. Follow the policy exactly. Campaign-only contacts must never start a follow-up sequence. Do not send before the required inactivity window. Respect the tenant timezone and preferred send time. Stop on any configured stop condition. Use the current sequence step purpose to shape the message, but generate it dynamically from real property/service context. Never invent facts. Return strict JSON only using this schema: '+JSON.stringify(schema),input:JSON.stringify({event_type:env.event_type,channel:env.channel,customer:env.input.customer||{},lead:env.input.lead||{},task:env.input.task||{},conversation:env.input.conversation||{},follow_up_context:env.input.follow_up_context||env.input,policy,eligibility:gate.eligibility})}}}];

const ctx=$('Build Policy-Aware Follow-up Request').first().json; let raw=$json.output_text||$json.text||$json.response_text; if(!raw&&Array.isArray($json.output)) raw=$json.output.flatMap(x=>x.content||[]).map(x=>x.text||x.output_text||'').join(''); raw=String(raw||'').replace(/^```json\s*/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); let d; try{d=JSON.parse(raw)}catch{throw new Error('Invalid follow-up AI JSON: '+raw.slice(0,300))} const actions=['send','reschedule','handoff','close','skip']; d.action=actions.includes(d.action)?d.action:'skip'; d.sequence_step=Math.max(1,Math.min((ctx.policy.sequence||[]).length||1,Number(d.sequence_step||ctx.input.sequence_step||1))); d.handoff_required=Boolean(d.handoff_required||d.action==='handoff'); d.stop_sequence=Boolean(d.stop_sequence||d.action==='close'); d.memory_facts=Array.isArray(d.memory_facts)?d.memory_facts:[]; if(d.action==='send'&&!String(d.message||'').trim()) throw new Error('Follow-up send action requires message'); return [{json:{...ctx,decision:d,provider_usage:$json.usage||{},provider_response_id:$json.id||null}}];

const r=$json; const actions=[]; if(r.handoff_required) actions.push({type:'handoff',payload:r.handoff}); if(r.reschedule_action) actions.push({type:'follow_up',payload:r.reschedule_action}); if(r.reply_action) actions.push({type:'reply',payload:r.reply_action}); return [{json:{...r,actions}}];
